mentions.name: Breadboard
mentions.description: A modern HyperCard-style visual environment for building web apps. It recently added an AI integration starting with a UI agent, using a BYOK (bring your own key) approach so anyone can try the assistant in the playground without signing in; it currently connects to Gemini. A logic agent is in progress, built to work with Breadboard's visual-stacked-instructions language based on Hyperscript, and documentation is being released.
